Supreme Court Declines Urgent Hearing on Ram Temple Donation Theft Case

An alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya has led to an FIR naming eight individuals. The Ayodhya Bar Association has resolved not to defend the accused and imposed a penalty for violations. The Supreme Court has declined to grant an urgent hearing for a plea seeking a CBI probe into the matter, stating "heavens won't fall."
